what: Tall vertical cards fan out around a big wheel below the screen, each tilted 12° (wide screens show two cards on each side, narrow ones one) — every 3 seconds the wheel rolls one notch and the cards move into place with a 1s ease, hovering pauses it, and dragging past 50px flips forward or back. Clicking a dot jumps quickly at .1s per notch to land on that section

options.delay: Auto-advance interval (ms), default 3000 — 0 means no auto-advance
options.per: At 1280 and up, how many card widths fit in one screen width, default 4 (card width = Screen/4 − 12)
options.phone: Card width ratio at 768 and below, default .85
options.pad: Extra space to leave empty below the wheel (px, card text area), default 110
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Dot buttons (children, if any) — in card order, is-active on the current section
options.--fx-ease: Transition curve (via style), default ease — reference site cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) (close to expo.out)

note: The original also accepts finger drag — here too, touchstart is received as passive so page scroll is not blocked

from.where: index.html .bm-wheel (hero cover card wheel — original #main-visual: rlCount 2 (1280 and up)·1, radius = screen/2 ÷ sin(2π/(30/rl)) + card height/2, mobile sin(2π·3.5/180), transform 1s ease, 3 seconds, drag 50px)

index.html .nh-radial gallery — wheel of radius 100rem with card width+10em spacing (≈14°), no auto advance · drag · prev/next buttons, 1.2s expo.out → delay: 0; step: 14; ratio: 1.25 · style="--fx-dur: 1.2s; --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)"
